pin.pinnedHelp: Always included in the model's context when it fits.

indicator.label: Context window usage
indicator.actual: Used by the last answer, as reported by the server

source.default: not reported by the server; default

indicator.exact: Counted with the model's own tokenizer.
indicator.estimated: Estimated at about 3.5 characters per token.

parts.latest: Latest message, attachments and web pages

strategy.sliding: Older messages are left out when the window is full.
strategy.summarize: Older messages are summarized when the window is full.
strategy.off: Context management is off: everything is sent.

marker.dropped_one: {{count}} earlier message is not included in the model's context.
marker.dropped_other: {{count}} earlier messages are not included in the model's context.
marker.summarized_one: {{count}} earlier message is replaced by a summary in the model's context.
marker.summarized_other: {{count}} earlier messages are replaced by a summary in the model's context.
marker.summaryFailed: Summarizing failed, so older messages were left out instead.
marker.retried: The server rejected the first attempt as too long, so less history was sent.
marker.summaryHelp: The model sees this summary instead of the earlier messages. It is read-only and is rebuilt when those messages change.

strategy.label: Context strategy
strategy.help: What to do when this conversation no longer fits in the model's context window.
strategy.slidingHelp: Older exchanges are dropped, whole and oldest first. Fast and predictable.
strategy.summarizeHelp: Dropped exchanges are summarized by a model. Keeps more of the thread, costs an extra request now and then.
strategy.offHelp: The full branch is sent. If it is too long, the server's error is shown.

settings.title: Context window
settings.help: How Chimera fits long conversations into the model's context window.
settings.summaryModelHelp: A smaller model can write summaries faster. By default the chat's own model is used.
settings.fallback: Context size when the server doesn't report it (tokens)
settings.fallbackHelp: llama-server reports its size automatically. For other servers, set it here or per connection under Models.
settings.hysteresis: Trim target (% of the history budget)
settings.hysteresisHelp: When history must be cut, Chimera cuts down to this share and then keeps the start of the prompt unchanged for as long as it fits, so llama-server can reuse its prompt cache instead of re-reading the whole conversation.
settings.margin: Safety margin (% of the context window)
settings.marginHelp: Room kept free for estimation errors and chat-template tokens.
settings.reserve: Reserved for the answer when no maximum is set (tokens)
settings.reserveHelp: Set Max output tokens in the parameters to reserve exactly that much instead.

connection.title: Context window
connection.reportedSlots_one: {{size}} tokens per slot, reported by the server ({{count}} slot)
connection.reportedSlots_other: {{size}} tokens per slot, reported by the server ({{count}} slots)
connection.overrideHelp: Leave empty to use what the server reports. Set it for servers that don't report their context size.
